Translation: In the name of Allah, the Most Compassionate, the Most Merciful

Arabic text: اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
Translation: O Allah, send blessings upon Muhammad and the family of Muhammad
O He whom I hope for in every good

Arabic text: وَ آمَنُ سَخَطَهُ عِنْدَ كُلِّ شَرٍّ
Translation: And I am secure from His anger at every evil
O He who gives much in return for little
O He who gives to those who ask Him

Arabic text: يَا مَنْ يُعْطِيْ مَنْ لَمْ يَسْأَلْهُ وَمَنْ لَمْ يَعْرِفْهُ
Translation: O He who gives to those who do not ask Him and do not know Him
Out of His tenderness and mercy

Arabic text: أَعْطِنِيْ بِمَسْأَلَتِيْ إِيَّاكَ جَمِيعَ خَيْرِ الدُّنْيَا
Translation: Grant me, by my asking You, all the good of this world
And all the good of the Hereafter
And avert from me, by my asking You
All the evil of this world and the evil of the Hereafter
For indeed what You give is never diminished
And increase me from Your bounty, O Generous One
O Possessor of Majesty and Honor
O Possessor of Blessings and Generosity
O Possessor of Favor and Power
Forbid my gray hair (old age) from the Fire
